auth: Cookie session (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict); mutations require exact Origin and X-CSRF-Token. Registration/login/recover require exact Origin and JSON.

routes.DELETE api/missions: delete all current and imported legacy histories; {ok}
routes.GET ready: {ok,library,audio,semantic_required,semantic}; 503 if required library, audio, or enabled semantic checker is unavailable
routes.POST api/auth/recovery-codes: {password} -> {recovery_codes}; authenticated, CSRF-protected, atomically invalidates prior codes
routes.POST api/missions/{id}/clarify: {request_id,step_id,intent_id,turn_index,turn_id} -> {session,reply,matched:false,feedback,clarified:true,match_source:learner_confirmation}; learner selects a meaning for the latest unmatched turn, recorded as supported practice
routes.GET api/progress: {sessions:[{id,mission_id,status,updated_at}]} account-scoped, at most 200 summaries; excludes conversation and snapshots

matching: An explicitly authored exact reply matches only an entire normalized token sequence and may deliberately include a negation. Otherwise every required group must match and reject terms block; unknown or multiple matching intents never advance. Completion requires all authored objectives. Sessions freeze scenario, mission, criteria, framework and content version.
limits: One audio job at a time; 12 MiB/180 sec audio; 200 missions per account; request IDs deduplicated and cannot be reused with different input.; 128 KiB per mission record; invitation expires in seven days by default.
semantic_integration: Experimental, disabled by default. BP5_SEMANTIC_REQUIRED=1 uses an unavailable placeholder and returns 503 with no turn mutation until a separately validated checker replaces it. No semantic model has passed the release gate.
semantic_capacity: Enabled semantic checking uses a persistent per-account weighted token bucket and occupancy-based cooldown. Provisional defaults: burst48, refill24units/minute, cooldown100% of slot occupancy capped300seconds; all legal single requests fit. Busy/cached/unauthorized/already-stale requests cost0; admitted failures remain charged. Reset/history deletion/restart do not refill; account deletion cascades state. Capacity429 includes Retry-After, preserves draft and means temporary availability, not incorrect Swedish. See PRODUCTION-RUNBOOK.md for bounded settings and cost formula.
